phase: Phase 6B — Diagnostic Audit and Validation-Only Improvement

diagnostic_audit_summary.root_cause_finding: In the validation split, KA15 (outer ring) has plastic deformation damage producing low vibration amplitude (RMS 0.191V, std 0.186V) and a positive DC offset (+0.0434V), which closely mimics inner ring validation bearing KI21 (RMS 0.240V, DC offset +0.0436V). In contrast, training outer ring bearings KA04 and KA16 are severe flaking fatigue damages with massive energy (RMS 0.42V-0.49V). Time-domain models therefore misclassify KA15 as inner ring damage.

experiments_comparison.model_name: Experiment 6B-B: SentinelAI + Projected Feature Fusion Layer

experiment_6bb_details.modification: Replacing naive concatenation with independent LayerNorm + Linear + GELU projection branches (proj_t and proj_f) followed by a 2-stage projection fusion layer.
experiment_6bb_details.rationale: Mitigate modality dominance of the 1D temporal branch by projecting both time and frequency representations into normalized latent spaces before fused classification.

scientific_conclusions.explanation: Neither training-derived class weighting (6B-A) nor projected feature fusion (6B-B) altered the validation predictions. The model persistently misclassifies validation bearing KA15 as inner-ring damage because KA15's physical time-domain profile (plastic deformation, small amplitude, positive DC offset) exactly mirrors the training inner-ring distribution (KI16, KI18). Frequency-Only remains the sole model that achieved non-zero outer-ring recall on validation (0.2303 recall, 0.6152 macro-F1) because it relies on harmonic peak locations rather than time-domain amplitude.
scientific_conclusions.test_set_policy_adherence: The test set was strictly NOT evaluated during Phase 6B. All experimental decisions remain governed by validation Macro-F1.
